capabilities: Move the current note to a preset folder from a header button menu
Configure an ordered list of favorite folders with short aliases
Search all vault folders for occasional one-off moves
Update internal links to the note via Obsidian's rename
Rename the moved note instead of overwriting on name conflicts
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states the folder search does not depend on the core Files plugin.
intentEvidence: Moving a note in Obsidian means right-click → Move file to… → type the folder name, every time
problem: Moving a note in Obsidian requires right-click, choosing Move file to, and typing the folder name every time, even though notes usually go to the same few folders.
summary: One-click note mover that adds a header button opening a menu of preset folders, with aliases, link updates and mobile support.
